prompt:
Production Unity sprite animation sheet for Rusher. Reference defines exact enemy identity, silhouette and perspective. Create redrawn articulated action frames of this same creature. Matte dark rock-brown armor, pale gray-white sinew, subtle amber slit eyes, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D style. Fixed elevated 45deg game view, soft upper-left lighting. Lean athletic quadruped with very long sharp spear/wedge-shaped head and tall swept-back layered rocky armor blade along spine; dark brown plates, pale gray sinewy load-bearing legs, amber eye slit at front. FOUR limbs, single head; no sacs, no flower organs. Preserve the reference's blade-backed charging predator silhouette.
EVERY frame faces: REAR THREE-QUARTER facing away toward upper-left, rear legs nearest viewer, nose toward upper-left. Never front-left. No camera or body angle changes during abilities/death. Rear views keep rear feet closest to viewer.
Grid EXACTLY FOUR columns and 7 rows; 28 complete separate bodies. PORTRAIT canvas width-to-height 4:7. Each creature fits middle 60% of its cell; generous transparent gutters so no neighboring toes/armor touch. Same body scale and ground anchor throughout. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential WALK frames with real articulated four-leg gait, alternating diagonal pairs, lifted feet and planted feet, stable torso. Row3: FOUR distinct IDLE breath poses, feet planted. Row4: FOUR WINDUP frames: progressively brace hind legs, lower spear head, draw torso backward ready to charge; last frame fully braced. Rows5-6: EIGHT sequential CHARGE SPRINT frames, head lowered and armor forward, vigorous alternating reach/push leg motions, body stays at the same scale and ground anchor. Row7: FOUR DEATH frames: limbs buckle, spear head and plates settle on floor, eyes darken, collapsed corpse, no explosion.
Draw genuine distinct joint motion; do not copy identical stills or merely rotate/scale. Maintain anatomy and plate layout. Full transparent alpha0 background, including between legs. No opaque brown backdrop, no ground/shadow, text, labels, grid, particles or projectiles.
